label: Table 14.1
caption: Table 14.1 Limitations on roof coverings
description:
The table is titled “Table 14.1 Limitations on roof coverings”. It is a grid. The left-hand column is headed “Designation(1) of covering of roof or part of roof”. The four right-hand columns are grouped under the heading “Distance from any point on relevant boundary”, and their individual headings are, from left to right, “Less than 6m”, “At least 6m”, “At least 12m” and “At least 20m”. The row headings are “BROOF(t4)”, “CROOF(t4)”, “DROOF(t4)”, “EROOF(t4)” and “FROOF(t4)”, each shown with “ROOF” in subscript to the preceding letter. In the image each distance cell contains either a filled black circle or an empty circle. Some filled circles have small superscript note references beside them.

In the “BROOF(t4)” row, all four distance columns have a filled black circle: “Less than 6m” has a filled black circle, “At least 6m” has a filled black circle, “At least 12m” has a filled black circle, and “At least 20m” has a filled black circle.

In the “CROOF(t4)” row, “Less than 6m” has an empty circle. “At least 6m” has a filled black circle, “At least 12m” has a filled black circle, and “At least 20m” has a filled black circle.

In the “DROOF(t4)” row, “Less than 6m” has an empty circle. “At least 6m” has a filled black circle with the small note references “(1)” and “(3)” beside it. “At least 12m” has a filled black circle with the small note reference “(1)” beside it. “At least 20m” has a filled black circle with no note reference.

In the “EROOF(t4)” row, “Less than 6m” has an empty circle. “At least 6m” has a filled black circle with the small note references “(1)” and “(3)” beside it. “At least 12m” has a filled black circle with the small note reference “(2)” beside it. “At least 20m” has a filled black circle with the small note reference “(2)” beside it.

In the “FROOF(t4)” row, “Less than 6m” has an empty circle, “At least 6m” has an empty circle, and “At least 12m” has an empty circle. “At least 20m” has a filled black circle with the small note references “(1)” and “(3)” beside it.

Below the grid, the key shows a filled black circle followed by the word “Acceptable.” and an empty circle followed by the word “Not acceptable.”

The notes section is headed “NOTES:” and says: “Separation distances do not apply to enclosed/covered walkways. However, see Diagram 8.2 if the roof passes over the top of a compartment wall. Polycarbonate and uPVC rooflights that achieve a class C-s3, d2 rating by test may be regarded as having a BROOF(t4) classification.”

The numbered notes are:

“1. The designation of external roof surfaces is explained in Appendix B”.

“2. Not acceptable on any of the following buildings. a. Industrial, storage or other non-residential purpose group (purpose groups 6 and 7) buildings of any size. b. Any other buildings with a cubic capacity of more than 1500m3.”

“3. Acceptable on buildings not listed in (2) if both of the following apply. a. Part of the roof has a maximum area of 3m2 and is a minimum of 1500mm from any similar part. b. The roof between the parts is covered with a material rated class A2-s3, d2 or better.”

In the image, the “3” in “1500m3” and the “2” in “3m2” are shown as superscripts, and the note references beside the circles are small superscript numbers. The table has a green title band and green rules; no cell shading is used as a symbol or given a separate meaning in the table.
